name: @draht/coding-agent
description: Coding agent CLI with read, bash, edit, write tools and session management

scripts.build:unbundled: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs executable dist/cli.js dist/rpc-entry.js && bun run copy-assets
scripts.build:binary: npm --prefix ../telemetry run build && bun run build && bun build --compile --no-compile-autoload-bunfig --no-compile-autoload-dotenv --compile-autoload-package-json ./dist/bun/cli.js ./src/utils/image-resize-worker.ts ./src/extensions/codemode/worker.ts --outfile dist/draht && bun run copy-binary-assets
scripts.copy-assets: node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy "src/modes/interactive/theme/*.json" dist/modes/interactive/theme && node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy "src/modes/interactive/assets/*.png" dist/modes/interactive/assets && node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy src/core/export-html/template.html src/core/export-html/template.css src/core/export-html/template.js dist/core/export-html && node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy "src/core/export-html/vendor/*.js" dist/core/export-html/vendor && node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs clean dist/prompts dist/skills dist/hooks dist/agents && node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy prompts skills hooks agents dist
scripts.copy-binary-assets: node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy package.json README.md CHANGELOG.md docs examples prompts skills hooks agents dist && node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy "src/modes/interactive/theme/*.json" dist/theme && node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy "src/modes/interactive/assets/*.png" dist/assets && node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy src/core/export-html/template.html dist/export-html && node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy "src/core/export-html/vendor/*.js" dist/export-html/vendor && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync(require.resolve('@silvia-odwyer/photon-node/photon_rs_bg.wasm'), 'dist/photon_rs_bg.wasm')"
scripts.prepublishOnly: node ../../scripts/sync-draht-tools.mjs && node ../../scripts/sync-checks-runtime.mjs --check && bun run clean && bun run build

author: Oskar Freye
